pg-test.probe: docker exec mcp-notes-pg-test psql -U postgres -tAc "select 'pid '||pid||' on '||datname||' waits on '||wait_event_type||'/'||wait_event||' for '||extract(epoch from now()-query_start)::int||'s' from pg_stat_activity where datname like 'mcp_notes%' and state = 'active' and wait_event_type in ('Lock','IO','IPC') order by query_start limit 1" 2>/dev/null
pg-test.notes: Docker Postgres mcp-notes-pg-test (55433) and mcp-notes-pg-connectors (55435). scripts/test-int.sh gives each worktree its own databases (TEST_DB_SUFFIX), so runs never collide; the cap of 2 bounds disk load, which is what stretched a ~5 minute suite to ~30 on 2026-11-11. verify-notesd needs no entry: every run gets its own database, port and data dir.
